# Fira Sans

- Family: Fira Sans, static Regular (400) and Medium (500), version 4.203.
- Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/Fira (Mozilla Foundation and Telefonica S.A.).
- Binaries: google/fonts commit c30b221beb0c1da59d563feb91ec8656a1fa972a, `ofl/firasans/FiraSans-Regular.ttf` and
  `FiraSans-Medium.ttf` (https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/c30b221beb0c1da59d563feb91ec8656a1fa972a/ofl/firasans).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in `OFL.txt`.
- Use: UI v2 text stack (`ui2-text`) tests and skin fonts. See `third_party/NOTICE-ui-fonts.md`.
